manifest.name: @sieuno/dsh-native-collab
manifest.description: Deepseek Harness Agent协作增强（基于原版插件）. DeepSeek Harness agent collaboration enhancements (based on the original plugin). Unofficial community plugin / 非官方社区插件。

bundle.text:
# 启动故障排查（给 Agent 与维护者看的注释，不参与运行时求值）：
# 如果安装、禁用或卸载本插件后 DSH 启动失败，先确认是否有“外部启动覆盖文件”仍在引用本插件。
# 常见位置：Profile 目录下由本机启动器生成的 *.patch.json 覆盖文件，例如
#   desktop-next.cordis.patch.json / desktop-next.runtime.patch.json
# 这类覆盖优先级高于 Profile 的 cordis.patch.yml；插件卸载或回退后，其中残留的
#   @sieuno/dsh-native-collab（含 /subagent、/agent-team、/tool-* 子路径）与 dsh-native-collab-ui 行
# 会让启动直接失败。处理顺序：
#   1) 完全停止 DSH 进程；2) 备份上述覆盖文件与 Profile patch；
#   3) 删除覆盖文件中所有指向本插件的行（不确定时先整份改名备份为 *.bak）；
#   4) 检查 Profile 的 cordis.patch.yml / cordis.yml，移除同类残留行；
#   5) 重启同一 Profile；仍失败时把本入口 dsh-native-collab-ui 行的 disabled 置为 true 再重启，先回原生服务。
# 只删除失效条目，不要清空 patch，不要删除会话或用量记录。完整步骤见 docs/FAQ.md。
# Only insert rows are component switches: one management entry owns the runtime.
# Pure startup expressions inspect the complete sibling config (not live services).
# Disabling this entry restores native roots after a full Profile restart.
- id: subagent
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent'
  disabled: &collabOwnsRuntime !!js |
    ctx[Symbol.for('cordis.entry')].parent.data.some(row => row.id === 'dsh-native-collab-ui' && row.name === '@sieuno/dsh-native-collab' && (row.disabled === undefined || row.disabled === false))
- id: agent-team
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team'
  disabled: *collabOwnsRuntime
- id: tool-agent-team
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team'
  disabled: *collabOwnsRuntime
# These are existing declarations, NOT new preset rows. Their configs are intact.
# Both native and managed modes provide subagents, so this gate has no UI-service
# dependency and cannot strand native presets when the management row is disabled.
- id: preset-standard
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
  inject: [subagents]
- id: preset-minimal
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
  inject: [subagents]
- id: preset-ptc
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
  inject: [subagents]
- id: preset-cordis
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
  inject: [subagents]
# Old independently inserted derived rows must not start a second provider set.
- id: dsh-native-collab-subagent
  name: '@sieuno/dsh-native-collab/subagent'
  disabled: true
- id: dsh-native-collab-agent-team
  name: '@sieuno/dsh-native-collab/agent-team'
  disabled: true
- id: dsh-native-collab-tool-agent-team
  name: '@sieuno/dsh-native-collab/tool-agent-team'
  disabled: true
- id: dsh-native-collab-tool-subagent-control
  name: '@sieuno/dsh-native-collab/tool-subagent-control'
  disabled: true
- id: dsh-native-collab-tool-subagent-list-agents
  name: '@sieuno/dsh-native-collab/tool-subagent-control/list-agents'
  disabled: true
- id: dsh-native-collab-tool-subagent
  name: '@sieuno/dsh-native-collab/tool-subagent'
  disabled: true
- id: dsh-native-collab-tool-subagent-fork
  name: '@sieuno/dsh-native-collab/tool-subagent/fork'
  disabled: true
- insert:
    - id: "dsh-native-collab-ui"
      name: "@sieuno/dsh-native-collab"
      disabled: false
      config:
        runtimeMode: managed

readme.section: DSH Native Collab · 原生协作增强
readme.text:
**Deepseek Harness Agent 协作增强（基于原版插件）**：为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供子 Agent 沟通增强、Team 成员与子 Agent 身份互转、灵活的模型选择及运行限制管理，是修改自 DSH 的**非官方社区插件**（非官方发行版）。

[English](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/README.en.md) · [安装指南](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md) · [常见问题 (FAQ)](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md) · [反馈](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/issues)

---
从 **0.3.1** 起，同一个插件包支持 DSH **0.2.1（自 rc.1 起）和 0.2.2 系列，含预发布版**；0.3.0 及更早版本仅支持 0.2.1 系列。插件要求 Node.js ≥22.19.0；使用 DSH 0.2.2 时还需满足宿主的 Node.js ≥24.9.0 要求。

在**你当前使用的 Profile** 下安装即可，无需先停止正在运行的实例（安装只向该 Profile 写入依赖）。把 `<profile>` 换成实际使用的 Profile 名（GUI 默认通常是 `web`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @sieuno/dsh-native-collab
```

启用/禁用插件后需重启DSH生效。

重启后进入插件管理页面：

- **子智能体设置**：本插件设置页代理原生最大递归深度与并行数量上限，进入页面自动读取，合法修改后自动写回原生 `subagent` 配置。后续委派与容量准入读取同一来源，切回原生服务仍保留；不改变原有深度规则。
- **增强偏好自动保存**：沟通、模型来源与自动唤醒等偏好修改后自动保存；若未确认或失败，对应项旁显示错误提示。
- **生效方式**：模型来源立即生效于后续的模型查询与创建；增强开关及连续自动唤醒轮数上限等启动配置，在按提示正常关闭服务并重启同一 Profile 后应用（单纯刷新网页不算重启）。
- **卸载与清理**：卸载前请先禁用插件，并重启同一 Profile 确认已恢复原生服务；若启动覆盖中仍有引用，直接卸载可能导致 DSH 找不到插件而启动失败。恢复步骤见[常见问题 (FAQ)](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md)。
- **启动失败排查**：卸载或降级后若 DSH 无法启动，先检查 Profile 目录下的 `*.patch.json` 外部启动覆盖文件是否仍引用本插件，再清理 Profile patch 中的残留行；步骤见[常见问题 (FAQ)](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md)。

| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| Team / Subagent 身份互转 | 支持在对话面板中将空闲的直属子 Agent 加入 Team，或将 Team 成员转为独立子 Agent；完整保留会话 ID、聊天历史、模型配置及工作目录，并具备防误触与状态安全保护。 |
| 子 Agent 沟通增强 | 插件配置页提供增强主开关，并支持“工作中接收补充要求”与“允许继续已完成的子对话”；关闭增强后保留原生基础能力与权限规则。 |
| Team 与子 Agent 模型选择 | 统一提供三种模型来源：对话开始时设置的子模型列表、DSH 当前设置的子模型列表、当前 DSH 全部可用模型；后两者在每次查询或创建 Agent 时重新读取，并遵循模型适配器与权限校验。 |
| 子 Agent 运行限制配置 | 在插件设置页统一读取与配置最大递归深度与并行数量上限，直接同步读写原生 `subagent` 设置，无需维护两套副本。 |
| 连续自动唤醒轮数上限 | 默认 32 轮，由会话所有 Agent 共享，防止多 Agent 协作死循环；只统计无用户输入介入的连续自动唤醒，用户输入或进程重启即清零，子任务完成/停止的自动回报不受此限。 |
本插件提供的工具与原生客户端一致，但重写了工具实现。在不额外增加臃肿的工具注入下，极大提升了使用子会话/Subagent的舒适性。

本插件适合原型开发、日常项目维护和个人开发等轻量协作场景。选择协作方案时，建议按任务间的依赖和协作复杂度，而非仅按项目规模判断：若需要更复杂的团队组织与工作流，可考虑 [dsh-agent-teams](https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams) 等更完整的协作方案。

插件沿用官方协作系统的任务指派与分工方式，增强现有工具，而不额外引入一套庞杂的工具。建议从一个能力较强的 **Lead + 多角色 Subagent** 开始，为各角色选择合适模型，并明确职责、输入、交付物与验收标准；需要长期命名成员、持续协作或共享任务板时，再使用 Team。欢迎在讨论区分享实践心得！

插件 patch 只插入一个管理入口，由其统一管理三个后台服务。三个原生根服务与管理入口状态互斥：入口启用时运行增强托管服务；关闭入口后重启DSH即可恢复原生服务。

四个协作工具针对四种已知 AgentPreset 在内存中按模块身份与 ID 动态适配，不修改或锁定用户原有预设文件，亦不影响未知自定义 provider。

服务切换通过 DSH 的 Profile patch 机制完成，而非由本插件追加 `--override` 启动参数。管理入口启用时，patch 会禁用对应的三个原生根服务，避免与增强服务重复运行；官方实验包的四个根层工具仍保持禁用。若本机启动器另行生成外部启动覆盖文件，应按 FAQ 检查其中是否有残留引用。

[开发说明](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) · [测试说明](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/TESTING.md) · [更新日志](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

本项目源自 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)，遵循 [MIT License](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/LICENSE)，保留版权与 NOTICE 说明；上游来源与第三方声明见 [UPSTREAM.md](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/UPSTREAM.md) 与 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

readme.section: DSH Native Collab · Native Collaboration Enhancements
readme.text: **DeepSeek Harness agent collaboration enhancements (based on the original plugin)**: child Agent communication enhancements, Team/Subagent identity exchange, flexible model selection, and runtime limit management for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). An **unofficial community plugin** derived from DSH (not an official distribution).

readme.section: DSH Native Collab · Native Collaboration Enhancements
readme.text:
[中文](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/README.md) · [Installation Guide](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.en.md) · [FAQ](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/blob/main/docs/FAQ.en.md) · [Issues](https://github.com/Sieuno/dsh-native-collab/issues)

---

Starting with **0.3.1**, a single plugin package supports the DSH **0.2.1 (from rc.1) and 0.2.2 series, including prereleases**. Versions 0.3.0 and earlier support only the 0.2.1 series. The plugin requires Node.js ≥22.19.0; when using DSH 0.2.2, you must also meet the host requirement of Node.js ≥24.9.0.

Install into **the Profile you currently use**; there is no need to stop the running instance first (installation only writes dependencies into that Profile). Replace `<profile>` with your Profile name (the GUI default is usually `web`):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @sieuno/dsh-native-collab
```

Restart DSH after enabling or disabling the plugin for the change to take effect.

After the restart, open the plugin management page:

- **Subagent Settings**: This plugin’s settings page edits the native maximum recursion depth and parallelism on behalf of the unavailable native page. Values load automatically; valid changes save back to the original `subagent` configuration. Subsequent delegation and capacity admission use the same source, and switching back to native services preserves it. Existing depth rules are unchanged.
- **Enhancement Preferences Save Automatically**: Communication, model source, and automatic wake-up preferences save automatically; unconfirmed or failed saves show an error beside the affected item.
- **Activation**: Model source changes apply immediately to subsequent model queries and Agent creation; startup settings, including enhancement toggles and the consecutive automatic wake-up limit, apply after you shut down the service normally as prompted and restart the same Profile (a browser refresh alone is not a restart).
- **Uninstallation & Cleanup**: Disable the plugin first, then restart the same Profile and confirm that native services have been restored before uninstalling. If startup overlays still reference the plugin, uninstalling it directly may prevent DSH from starting becaus

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Team / Subagent Identity Exchange | Convert direct, idle subagents under the current Lead into Team members, or turn Team members into standalone subagents from the conversation header popover; preserves session ID, chat history, model configuration, and working directory with built-in safety checks. |
| Child Agent communication enhancements | The plugin settings page provides a main enhancement switch plus "accept additional instructions while working" and "allow continuing completed child conversations"; disabling enhancements retains native capabilities and permission rules. |
| Model selection for Team and child Agents | Three model sources: the child model list set at conversation start, the child model list in current DSH settings, and all models currently available in DSH; the latter two are re-read on every query or Agent creation, subject to model adapter and permission checks. |
| Subagent runtime limit configuration | Directly read and configure maximum recursion depth and concurrency limits from the plugin settings page, synchronized directly with native `subagent` settings without maintaining duplicate stores. |
| Consecutive auto

The plugin provides the same tools as the native client, but rewrites their implementations. This greatly improves the experience of working with child conversations/Subagents without injecting a bulky set of additional tools.

This plugin suits lightweight collaboration such as prototyping, routine project maintenance, and personal development. Choose a collaboration approach based on task dependencies and coordination complexity, not project size alone. If you need more elaborate team organization and workflows, consider a more comprehensive solution such as [dsh-agent-teams](https://github.com/NanmiCoder/dsh-agent-teams).

The plugin retains the official collaboration system's task assignment and division of responsibilities, enhancing existing tools rather than adding a large new toolset. Start with a capable **Lead + role-specific Subagents**, choose suitable models for each role, and define responsibilities, inputs, deliverables, and acceptance criteria. Use Team when you need long-lived named members, ongoing collaboration, or a shared task board. Share your experiences in Discussions!

The plugin patch inserts only one management entry, which manages three backend services. The three native root services and the management entry are mutually exclusive: enabling the entry runs the enhanced managed services; disabling it and restarting DSH restores native services.

Four collaboration tools are dynamically adapted in memory for the four known AgentPresets by module identity and ID, without modifying or pinning users' existing preset files or affecting unknown custom providers.

Service switching uses DSH's Profile patch mechanism; this plugin does not append a `--override` startup argument. When the management entry is enabled, the patch disables the three corresponding native root services to avoid running duplicate providers alongside the enhanced services. The four root-level tools from the official experimental package remain disabled. If a local launcher generates additional external startup overlays, check them for stale references as described in the FAQ.
